claim.quote: Extensive simulations of all presently known backgrounds do not provide a viable background explanation for the excess of low-energy events in the CoGeNT data, or the previously observed temporal variation in the event rate.

name: CoGeNT: A Search for Low-Mass Dark Matter using p-type Point Contact Germanium Detectors

summary.plain: A detailed study of the CoGeNT detector and its backgrounds found that no known background explains the low-energy excess or the earlier rate variation.
summary.technical: Detector description (shielding, DAQ, stability), surface (slow-rise-time) event contamination as a function of energy, and a full background model for the 442-live-day data set; concludes that the PPC technology is well suited to a DAMA/LIBRA-region annual-modulation search.

title: CoGeNT: A Search for Low-Mass Dark Matter using p-type Point Contact Germanium Detectors
why_it_matters: The collaboration's own detailed answer to whether backgrounds could mimic the excess.
